Thanks Sam - great call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned before we kick off the trial: 

Recap:
- Scope: 2-week POC to validate Redwood inference for clinical notes summarization at ~20k tokens/day.
- Key stakeholders: Sam (Clinical Ops), Priya (Product), IT Security (cc'd).
- Success criteria (high-level): 1) 95% acceptable extractive summary quality on our sample set, 2) median inference latency <= 300ms, 3) no PII left in logs, and 4) integration with your S3 test bucket for ingest.

Proposed next steps:
1) Finalize success criteria and data access by EOD Tue 11/3.
2) We'll share a PoC plan + SOW draft - Marcus (SE) will run the environment setup.
3) Kickoff environment prep and sample upload (you/IT) - target start Mon 11/8.
4) Midpoint sync and final readout the week after (we'll propose times below).

Please confirm the success criteria above or suggest edits. I've attached a one-page PoC plan + an editable success-criteria sheet for your team to fill out.

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.pdf, poc-success-criteria.xlsx

Thanks,

- Evaluation (Week 2): Product/Clinical Ops review results, capture regressions & issues, tie back to success criteria.

Ownership:
- Redwood SE (Marcus): infra + environment setup, model selection and quantization profile recommendations.
- Redwood CS (Rishi): runbooks, quality monitoring, and readout prep.
- Acme (Priya/Sam): sample labeling, acceptance testing, procurement coordination.

Start target: Mon 2026-11-08. Let us know if IT needs extra time for VPC peering. I've attached the SOW draft for procurement review - it's intentionally minimal to speed the POC.

- Marcus: provide infra checklist and temporary creds instructions by 11/05.

Thanks - quick technical note / checklist from my side: 

1) Network & access
- Need a temporary service account with S3 read access to the dev bucket OR a signed URL for the sample set.
- If running in Acme VPC, we'll need outbound for model pull & telemetry to redwood-infra (IP ranges attached).

2) Test dataset
- Please include 500 de-identified records; include a small labeled subset (~50) for evaluation.

3) Performance targets to validate in POC
- Median latency target: <=300ms for standard sized notes (we'll test at 1-2k tokens).
- Throughput: target 10 qps during peak batch tests.

4) Temporary creds / runbook
- I'll send instructions for a temporary credentials flow and the infra checklist by EOD 11/05.
